earnings.title: FIS Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Third quarter GAAP Diluted EPS of $0.69
Adjusted EPS of $1.61 increased 6.6% over the prior year period
Revenue increased 27% on a GAAP basis to $3.5 billion, increasing 29% on an adjusted basis and 3.7% on a Pro Forma basis
On a GAAP basis, revenue increased 27% as compared to the prior-year period to approximately $3.5 billion.
On an adjusted basis, revenue increased 29% as compared to the prior-year period.
outlook: Updated full-year 2026 outlook, including Adjusted revenue growth of 28 - 29%, Adjusted EBITDA growth of 29 - 30%, Adjusted EPS growth of 1.2 - 2.4% and Free Cash Flow 1 growth of 33 - 39%, to $2,150 - $2,250 million
Updated 2026 outlook for Pro Forma revenue growth to 3.1 - 3.6% and Pro Forma Adjusted EBITDA growth to 2.9 - 3.6%
